about: Golden shots (docs/PEPPER-PRO.md §9.4): a fixed set across the four targets, rendered with fixed seeds whenever a recipe changes, so versions are compared on the same inputs. A shot runs on a recipe of its kind that has one of its capabilities. Inputs named in `inputs` are generated once by an installed recipe (see `generate`) and kept, except those marked `supply`, which you put in DATA_DIR/golden/inputs/.
